contention_note: results with contended_timing=true had their wall clocks measured concurrently with the user's live 12-13-process MPI job (engine_win64_impi); ALL M39 records are contended (the job ran the whole sweep). Per-case impi process counts are in each record's impi_procs field. Parity classes and channel rel-RMS are deterministic and unaffected; a borderline case can only be pushed to SKIPPED-SLOW if contention exhausts the port budget.
comparison_note: Fortran reference CSVs are CARRIED from M37 for c00..c51 (deterministic solver, unchanged binaries/decks) and GENERATED this round for c52+ (fresh Fortran run, or the deck's shipped T01); the port side is a FRESH M39 run. Channels are compared over the OVERLAP window [0, min(fortran, port) final time] interpolated onto the port grid (same semantics as M36/M37/M38). port_time_coverage = port final time / the deck's /RUN target; results < 1 carry a MATCH/DEVIATION label for only that fraction of the simulation.
